props.name: leading
props.description: Content before the text, e.g. an icon, avatar or thumbnail.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the text, e.g. a chevron, badge or count.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the bar as the chosen one in a list; sets aria-pressed.

examples.title: size sm
examples.code:
<CardBar
  size="sm"
  title="Timesheets"
  description="Hours for this week"
  leading={<ClockIcon className="size-3.5" />}
  trailing={<ChevronRightIcon className="size-3.5" />}
/>
